relations: Wet corneal reflection of yellow-green-cyan points slides downward, stretching into a thin horizontal streak.
As the band moves, a green flare extends left and a brighter white-yellow flare reaches right.
The blue iris and dark pupil stay nearly fixed while the open eye does not blink.
Pale right sclera threaded with red capillaries remains unchanged during the reflection's motion.
caption: An extreme macro view holds a single open human eye centered in frame, its blue iris and dark pupil ringed by brown lashes and lids. A wet corneal reflection of small yellow, green, and cyan lights sits across the lower iris, shimmering as individual points flicker. The reflected band gradually slides downward, stretching into a thin horizontal streak while a green flare extends left and a brighter white-yellow flare reaches right. The sclera on the right remains pale and threaded with red capillaries, and the eye itself does not blink. The pupil and iris stay nearly fixed as the light reflection continues to move across the eye's surface.
